pr_body:
##### Summary
Fixes  #8912
Fixes #8914

This PR brings the integration between the collectors eBPF and Apps.

##### Component Name
Collector
##### Test Plan
1 - Install Netdata using     `./netdata-installer.sh --dont-start-it`.
2 - Download the file [files4.zip](https://github.com/netdata/netdata/files/4762377/files4.zip) and extract it inside `/usr/libexec/netdata/plugins.d`.
3 - Run netdata and verify the charts on `apps.plugin`.
4 - Stop netdata after few seconds.
5 - Start netdata again.

Do the steps 4 and 5 at least 3 times. We should have consistency on all charts (general and apps) in all tests.

It is expected to see 14 charts inside apps submenu.


##### Additional Information

issue_context.title: Change threads to create charts inside `Apps` submenu
issue_context.body:
##### Feature idea summary
The eBPF programs are reading only hash table with global information from the thread, but they are also storing a PID statistics in another hash table. Netdata needs to read these information from kernel ring to make the charts.  To move this forward we need to do the following changes on the eBPF.plugin threads:

- Map the functions `bpf_map_get_next_key`, `bpf_map_delete_elem` and `bpf_map_lookup_elem` to get all PIDs  from the shared libraries to eBPF modules.
-  A function to create the charts when the collector is loaded, this chart will have the apps groups as dimensions.
- Another function that will read all the data from kernel ring to user ring. It will be interesting to use the 3 new functions mapped instead to use the current values present inside `/proc` to be sure we are reading all the information. 
- Finally we will have another function that will send new values for each dimension of the new charts.

The last two functions will be called inside the main loop of the thread.

##### Expected behavior
To have new charts inside apps.plugin.
